page.title: Roles
page.consoleHint: Console roles apply across the whole console: tenants, the brand list, users and roles. Each user has at most one.
page.brandHint: Brand roles are templates. You choose which brand when you assign one, on the Users page or a brand’s Members tab.

table.name: Name
table.ownRole: You can't change a role you hold.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.builtinHint: The built-in Admin role holds every console action and can't be changed.
dialog.lackedHint: You can only grant console actions you hold yourself.
dialog.brandHint: This role isn’t tied to a brand. You choose the brand when you assign it, on the Users page or a brand’s Members tab.
dialog.assignedUsersHint: To change who holds this role, use the Users page or the brand's Members tab.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: This role will be removed permanently. A role that is assigned to users can't be deleted.
